$description: RIVR design tokens, the single source of every design value (W3C Design Tokens format). Values come from docs/design/design-inventory.md. Edit here, then run `pnpm --filter @rivr/tokens build`.

green.$description: Deep green. Primary background on every surface.

greenBlack.$description: Green-black. Raised surfaces, nav bars, table rows on hover.

cream.$description: Primary text and the wordmark tiles.

gold.$description: The one primary action per screen, money that belongs to the player, hairlines at 25%.

red.$description: Alerts, negatives, the spade card in the mark. Nothing else.

ink.$description: Text on cream: the wordmark's tiles, and the public website's cream bands (decision 0118).

inkMuted.$description: Ink at 70%. Secondary text on the website's cream bands; at least 4.5:1 on cream.

inkEdge.$description: Ink at 50%. A control's edge and a rule on the website's cream bands (F-193); at least 3:1 on cream.

muted.$description: Cream at 60%. Secondary text; at least 4.5:1 on green.

hairline.$description: Gold at 25%. The 1 px rules that separate content.

control.$description: Cream at 50%. A form control's edge: an input, a switch's track when off, an unselected chip, a key. 3.89:1 on the page green and 4.37:1 on raised, past the 3:1 a control needs (F5-04); a hairline is 1.6:1.

goldTint.$description: Gold at 14%. A picked chip or time, the member's usual order, an open seat on the seat map (decision 0320).

goldEdge.$description: Gold at 35%. A neutral banner's edge and the selfie's frame on the membership card.

veg.$description: The veg mark on a menu item (FSSAI's green), on cream.

egg.$description: The club's own egg mark on a menu item, on cream: FSSAI marks only veg and non-veg.

nonVeg.$description: The non-veg mark on a menu item (FSSAI's brown), on cream.

practiceStripe.$description: The darker stripe between gold ones on the practice venue's banner across the console (console v3, decision 0477).

creamTrack.$description: Cream at 12%. The track under the call-time ring and a progress bar, and a paused action's fill.

creamFaint.$description: Cream at 30%. A sheet's grabber, a picker field's edge and a step not reached.

seatTaken.$description: Cream at 35%. A taken seat's dot on the tables list.

skeleton.$description: Cream at 8%. A first load's blocks, where its text will be.

skeletonFaint.$description: Cream at 5%. A first load's blocks, where its rows will be.

rim.$description: The wooden rim round the felt on the seat map.

scrim.$description: The dark veil behind an open sheet, and round the selfie's oval.

raised.$description: Raised surfaces: nav bars, rails, sheets, row hover.

action.$description: Fill of the one primary action on a screen.

accent.$description: A website eyebrow and its small marks; green on a cream band (decision 0118).

money.$description: Money that belongs to the player.

alert.$description: Alert and danger fills, negative markers.

subtle.$description: Cream at 5%. The console's filled controls in place of outlines (console v3, decision 0462): a subtle button, the search field, a segmented control's track, a chip. Text on it is cream: muted text is 4.47:1 on it.

subtleHover.$description: Cream at 8%. A subtle fill under the pointer, and the rail's current screen.

selected.$description: Gold at 14%. A chosen row, option or seat on the console.

danger.$description: Danger text on the console: Remove, Purge, the Kill switch, an age past its target. 4.76:1 on green, 5.86:1 on green-black; never on a subtle fill.

chart.$description: Series colours for charts, in order. Each reads at 3:1 or better on green.

display.$description: Display only: wordmark, TV titles, the jackpot figure. Never below 20 px. Variable, with optical sizes; its ₹ sign, which Bodoni Moda lacks, is Noto Serif Display's, served inside the family (packages/ui/scripts/fonts.mjs).

text.$description: Everything else. Noto Sans Devanagari sets the ₹ sign, which Instrument Sans lacks.

15.$description: The console's body: a row's primary text, a tile's name (console v3).

32.$description: A sheet's title and a screen title on the player app (decision 0320).

40.$description: A sign-up and identity title on the player app.

48.$description: A player's name on the TV's waitlist board.

72.$description: A seat's hold counting down on the player app.

88.$description: A TV board's title, and tonight's high hand.

160.$description: The member's place on a waitlist, the largest thing on the player app.

280.$description: The TV's jackpot figure, the largest thing on any screen.

control.$description: A control's label: buttons, chips, pills, tiles, a banner's action. A whole number of pixels, so a label centred in a 44, 48, 52 or 54 px control starts on a pixel, never between two, where the rasteriser drew it one way or the other from run to run (#762).

tv.$description: Letter-spaced labels on the TV and under the wordmark.

code.$description: The digits of a one-time code, set apart to be read and typed.

opticalSize.$description: Bodoni Moda's optical size held for a title read from across a room (D-01): its hairlines vanish at the size it picks for 88 px.

space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4 px grid. Separation comes from spacing and hairlines, not boxes.

7.$description: The console's gap between sections, and a page's top padding (console v3).

touch.$description: Minimum touch target on the player app and the dealer tablet.

rail.$description: The console's rail with its labels (console v3).

railCollapsed.$description: The console's rail as icons alone: below 1200 px, or when the staff member folds it.

control.$description: A console control's height at a desk, from 1180 px: a compact button, the search field, a rail item. Below 1180 px the touch target (decision 0282).

row.$description: A console row at the comfortable density: a table's row, a seat, a list entry.

rowCompact.$description: A console row at the compact density.

sidePanel.$description: A console sheet at the side of the screen, from 768 px.

dock.$description: The Live floor's requests panel docked at the side of the screen, from 768 px (console v3).

dockStrip.$description: A docked panel folded to a strip with its count (console v3).

palette.$description: The console's command palette at its widest.

paletteList.$description: The command palette's results at their tallest; past it they scroll.

search.$description: The console header's search field at its widest.

playerFoot.$description: The player app's foot at its tallest, the tab bar and the peek of all tables above it (about 134 px), with room for a focus ring: how far scrolling keeps a focused control above it (WCAG 2.4.11).

header.$description: Top bar on phone and tablet shells.

consoleHeader.$description: The console's header and the rail's wordmark row beside it, as the console v3 prototype draws them.

photo.$description: A KYC photo beside its member's details, such as in the review queue.

column.$description: A table column's least width where the table scrolls sideways at every width: the docked Members table (owner, 9 Nov).

columnMenu.$description: A table column's menu: its order and its filter (owner, 9 Nov).

card.$description: The membership card at its widest.

action.$description: The player app's tall action button: a step's one gold action (decision 0320).

field.$description: A field with its label inside the box, a picker's field and a code cell.

round.$description: A round seat action, a rating button and a picker's option row.

tile.$description: An item's initial tile, an Add time choice and the verified check.

seat.$description: A seat on the seat map.

switchWidth.$description: A switch's track, as the prototype draws it (#786), in its 44 px row.

switchInset.$description: The gap between a switch's knob and its track's edge (#786).

switchTravel.$description: How far a switch's knob moves from off to on: the track's inside less the knob and both gaps (#786).

pip.$description: A seat's dot on the tables list, and a status row's dot.

seatMap.$description: The seat map's height in the join sheet.

holdBar.$description: The bar a seat's hold drains along.

offer.$description: An offer card's width in Tonight's carousel.

sheet.$description: A bottom sheet's greatest height; past it the sheet scrolls inside.

receipt.$description: A thermal receipt: 80 mm paper at 203 dpi, one CSS pixel to each printer dot.

chart.$description: The height of a chart's plot (#90): its width is the container's.

shareCard.$description: A share card's side (#153): a square image at the size chat and social apps show without scaling it.

print.$description: Printing from the browser, which prints 96 CSS pixels to the inch.

receiptScale.$description: Shrinks a size.receipt receipt to the 72 mm a 203 dpi printer prints on 80 mm paper: 96 / 203.

aspect.$description: Width to height of a shape the design fixes.

portrait.$description: A KYC photo: the selfie is taken 3:4.

photo.$description: A photo tile on the public website (#441), and a reward's or a dish's photo (ItemPhoto, AS-11).

story.$description: A phone screen upright, as the website shows the RIVR app (#441).

card.$description: The membership card: an ID-1 card, 85.6 by 54 mm.

video.$description: The website editor's preview of a draft, as a wide screen shows the page (F5-01).

radius.$description: Corner radius. 6 px is the maximum on product surfaces, besides the player app's card and sheet (decision 0320).

card.$description: An offer card, the QR's panel and the membership card on the player app.

sheet.$description: A bottom sheet's top corners, and the tables sheet on Tonight.

modal.$description: The only shadow, under a modal.

z.$description: Stacking layers: the sticky nav and header, the cookie banner, a sheet's overlay, and the sheet or drawer over it.

viewport.$description: The device each surface is designed for.

portrait.$description: A tablet held upright: the console's middle size (decision 0282).

feed.$description: A social post in the feed, 4:5.

story.$description: A social story or reel cover, 9:16.

card.$description: The membership card at a phone's content width; drawn at three times for an image.

a4.$description: An A4 page at 96 CSS pixels to the inch: invoices and statements.

brand.$description: The square stages brand art is drawn on, then scaled to each icon, splash screen and cover (the brand kit).

icon.$description: An app icon: the red card fills its middle.

maskable.$description: A maskable PWA icon: the card inside the safe circle, 80% of the width.

adaptive.$description: An Android adaptive icon's foreground: the card inside the safe zone, 66 of 108, with room to spare.

lockup.$description: A splash screen or cover: the wordmark and tagline.

wide.$description: The console's rail shows its labels from here; below, its icons alone, as on the floor's 1180 px tablets (console v3).

tv.$description: Reserved: no class uses it, as the TV stage scales rather than reflows; kept so each device has its breakpoint.

state.$description: State changes only: a seat filling, a sheet sliding in.

stagger.$description: The logo animation: the wait before the next tile rises. Each tile rises in the state duration.

tick.$description: A live timer's ring or bar moving on by one second, linear.

toast.$description: How long a toast stays before it goes.

toastUndo.$description: How long a toast with Undo stays, at least, so its change can be taken back: paused while hovered or focused, and closable (WCAG 2.2.1; audit F-009).

fresh.$description: A request just arrived on the console: its gold tint fades over this, ease-out (console v3, decision 0465).

turn.$description: One turn of a busy button's circle, which keeps turning while its action is in flight (F5-17); still under reduced motion.

stroke.$description: Line icons, 1.5 px stroke at every size.
